opening.argument: The title identifies a KineMaster video-layer tutorial, and the narration and visible editing screens follow through: viewers are shown the settings and layer menus and told to select the layer icon. The observable content supports an editing demonstration, with no basis here to infer a financial transaction or promised payout.
